title: dsh-deepcraft design tokens
description: The skin's custom properties: the build generates the token stylesheet and the docs/STYLE.md token table from this document (D9).

apex.description: Colours independent of the palette choice: the same value under every palette. Empty while nothing is painted regardless of the reader's palette.

palette.description: Colour tokens: every skin palette's light and dark themes, and the alias under the host palette (D80).

use.description: What the token paints, for the docs/STYLE.md table.

motion.description: Motion tokens (D9): durations, loop periods, easing curves, distances, blur and scale, and the two duration-and-curve shorthands. One value under every palette; the only place a stylesheet may write a time or a curve.

use.description: The role the token plays, for the docs/STYLE.md motion table.

layer.description: Layer tokens (D9): the stacking levels a skin surface takes against what the host draws around it. One value under every palette; the only place a stylesheet may write a z-index above the local orders 0 to 9.

use.description: What stands on this level and what it has to clear, for the docs/STYLE.md layer table.

note.description: Why the value has this shape; kept for maintainers, not emitted.

fullThemes.description: One skin palette's two themes: both are stated, so no palette inherits a value from another.
